samples.question: This image shows four tokens. Each token is a vertical stack of four flat gray tiles with a solid black tab touching exactly one end of the stack. The tab marks where the token's shade sequence starts, so a token is read tile by tile starting at its tab end: top to bottom when the tab is above the stack, bottom to top when the tab is below it. Each tile counts as one of three shades - dark, medium or light - and every token in the image uses the same four shades in some order, so only the order of the shades read from the tab end distinguishes the tokens. The token labeled REF at the top is the reference. The three lower tokens, labeled A, B and C from left to right, are each surrounded by a colored halo, and exactly one of them reads out the same shade sequence as REF. What is the halo color of that matching token? Answer red, blue, or green.
